text:
Which statement about the Sun is correct?
A
The Sun is a dwarf star consisting mostly of hydrogen and oxygen.
B
The Sun is a giant star consisting mostly of helium and carbon dioxide.
C
The Sun is a medium-sized star consisting mostly of hydrogen and helium.
D
The Sun is a medium-sized star consisting mostly of nitrogen and oxygen.

options.label: A
options.text: The Sun is a dwarf star consisting mostly of hydrogen and oxygen.

options.label: B
options.text: The Sun is a giant star consisting mostly of helium and carbon dioxide.

options.label: C
